scope: Generic mechanical capsule format and allowed own-project documentation only
constraints: Verify existing cap before reading its source/indexed files; preserve old cap manifest/seal bytes.
Fresh destination must be disjoint from original input, old cap, jobs and output. Reject linked ancestors before reads/writes.
Copy original175 sources/indexed bytes exactly. New material raw bytes must match protected-inputs-before SHA.
Use frozen capsule.decode(data), record its returned encoding, splitlines(keepends=True), six-digit numbered prefix, UTF8 bytes; no lossy decoding or newline normalization.
Keep exact lowercase input-relative nenkin path casing and canonical indexed/path.txt mapping; verify compares full actual inventory, not only declared entries.
New source entry contains path, bytes integer, sha256, encoding, lines integer, indexed. Remove corresponding omitted entries; retain other omitted entries.

Write fresh source-only manifest with referenceFiles empty/referenceSpecificationIncluded false/trainingReferenceAuthorizedByUser false/sourceBytesModified false/semanticAnalysisPerformedByPython false.
Write fresh seal whose manifestSha256 equals actual new manifest bytes SHA, then invoke unchanged frozen capsule.verify and verification_state.
Context must distinguish project-owned README/configuration declarations from observed implemented behavior or runtime verification. Do not read referenced accdb/WEB/Context paths.
Recheck original345 full membership/bytes and existing old output baseline independently; no input application/SQL/script execution.

nenkin/.classpath.role: Declared IDE classpath/source/output/dependency configuration; external referenced libraries not opened.

nenkin/.project.role: Declared IDE project/builder identity; no compile/runtime proof.
